item.body:
### Summary

As the lots LOT-100 (#191), we need a real, anonymized capture of this page state, so that the code is written against evidence, never a guess (LESSONS 35-36).

### What to capture

New-topic form: is there a poll section (fields, limits)? Check `R45a` first; capture only if absent

Note: read-only GET of the new-topic form

### Read-only or write

**Read-only** capture (GET only), no write to the forum or the third party.

### Wanted by

- LOT-100 (#191)

### Done when

- [ ] Raw capture taken with the LOT-001 kit (`tooling/fixtures/`), anonymized, checked independently, committed under the fixtures tree with its MANIFEST entry.
- [ ] The fact it settles is recorded in docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md (or the third-party notes of the LOT-071 spec for a non-HFR host), and each lot above is told on its issue.
- [ ] A legacy oracle is added when a parser consumes the page (LOT-002..005 tooling).

### Before you start (agents and humans)

Read, in order: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/FIXTURES.md, tooling/fixtures/README.md, docs/lots/LOT-001-*.md (fixture kit and capture checklist), and docs/agents/LESSONS.md rows 33, 34, 36 and 39 (independent anonymization check, quote-aware patterns, skipped rows go back to the capture session, redaction by position). Claim with `/claim <session-id>` on this issue before capturing; the PR says `Closes #<this issue>` + `Claim: <session-id>`. Captures are anonymized before commit and checked by an independent reviewer before any push; no cookie, `hash_check`, real pseudo or API key in any file. A write capture (anything that posts, deletes or sends) needs the operator's explicit approval first (AGENTS.md §0); use a throwaway account or own MP/test topic.
